214044.description:
Sometimes, when life is hard, you just need a "friend."

Working at a game company, Rihito Otsuka (23), is a "normal" guy who is a steady presence on and off the job. Noa Saotome (27) is a "hard-core" woman who likes to go all out at everything she does. Two people who usually wouldn't get along become "friends" by chance...? The is the start of a workplace "friendship" comedy that's a little sweet but also a little heavy!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend.

214259.description:
Nie Li travels to the Demon God Sect, makes new friends, embarks on a new journey, and vows to overthrow the Holy Emperor and protect the City of Glory!

(Source: Tencent Weibo Account)
synonyms: Tales of Demons and Gods Season 10

214260.description:
In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins...

(Source: iQ)

title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Shounin wa Kin no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukuu
title.native: 追放された商人は金の力で世界を救う

214582.description:
Torao, a merchant with an unpopular profession, was a member of an S-rank adventurer party. However, being mediocre in combat and caught embezzling funds, he is told: "You're fired!" And just like that, he's expelled from the party. Left with no choice, Torao teams up with the girls on whom he spent the embezzled money, aiming to defeat the Demon Lord. But their first job is shockingly to recover equipment from the corpses of his annihilated former party...!?

"It doesn't matter. You're not my comrades anymore."

Even if they say, "We always thought we were comrades," it's too late now...
synonyms: The Exiled Merchant Saves the World with the Power of Gold

214863.description:
This game’s got me obsessed! It’s like it’s taken over my life... wait—HARD MODE ACTIVATED. No-no-no-no-no! It has literally taken me and thrown me into the part of Penelope Eckhart. Love is easy as the heroine, but as the hated villainess, I’m trying very hard not to die… at the hands of my brothers… the prince… a fork… every possible ending is death! This world is stacked against me, but can my wits and insider game knowledge score the affection of these male characters? Or the reset button???

(Source: Tapas)

214049.description:
Kiritani, the vice-leader of the Kurotorikai yakuza group, is assigned to be the caretaker for Riyo Washizu, the daughter of the Washizugumi organization's grand chairman.

Although Kiritani initially thinks this task will be easy because Riyo appears obedient, Kiritani later discovers that Riyo has a specific fetish called 'Yowaraa.' This fetish makes Riyo feel aroused whenever she sees someone strong or tough become weak and helpless. The story focuses on the romantic comedy relationship between the young yakuza lady and her caretaker.

(Source: MAL News)

214551.description:
Oushun Girls’ Academy is a school attended by young women from noble families. The protagonist is hired there as a janitor. However, that is just his cover. His true role is that of an “actor”. All the students are from wealthy, high-society families. Scandals are strictly forbidden. —Consequently, the female students’ sexual desires are all the more intense and twisted. His job is to play the role of their “ideal man”. That is the duty assigned to the protagonist. His first client is “Saeki Ichijou”. She is the student council president, excelling in both academics and athletics, and comes from a prestigious family that has even produced a prime minister—a person truly destined to lead others. However, she harbors a secret sexual fetish she cannot reveal to anyone. To satisfy her, the protagonist plays a role: that of her “ideal man”… her “Master”.

(Source: Fanza, translated)

214974.description:
Ten years ago, after three consecutive days of blood moon, ghosts, gods, heterochromatic eyes, and strange tales arrived one after another. Mystery and enigma descended upon the human world. Terror and despair roamed the earth. As humans, should we kneel in submission, weep bitterly, or draw our swords? This is a new era, and this era—belongs to the extraordinary! Pushing open the door to the extraordinary, Su Bai encountered a new world…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

214368.description:
Keisuke Shizuki and Shizuka Kusunoki are taking high school by storm with their good looks, but they share a dark secret: they were both total outcasts in middle school! While Shizuki has succeeded in making himself over inside and out, clearing the slate of his past life, Kusunoki is still struggling to develop social skills to match her new appearance. She’s eager for Shizuki’s help, if only he could get over his phobia of pretty girls…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

214215.description:
Kaoru Terasaki is a gamer who’s into MMORPGs, and he’s finally meeting up with someone he’s been friends with in-game for a long while—this time, offline and in person. He’s worried that his friend will be disappointed to see Kaoru is a guy, unlike his female character in the game. But he’s the one who’s in for a surprise when, instead of another guy, his friend turns out to be a cute girl, Nanami Ousaka. On top of that, Nanami told her parents that she would be bringing a friend over—a female friend. Even worse, Nanami’s dad is the super overprotective type who won’t allow any guys near his daughter. There’s only one solution to this dilemma: Kaoru has to cross-dress as a girl! Will Kaoru’s efforts pay off in the end?! Will Kaoru and Nanami remain just friends, or will their time together IRL change everything? Follow their romantic-comedy adventures to find out!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie!

title.romaji: Real mo Tama ni wa Uso wo Tsuku

214332.description:
Yukari Maki is a high school girl who prides herself on honesty—and she’s starting to get the feeling that she and her delinquent classmate, Yusuke Kusaka, don’t have a single thing in common! But her straitlaced unwillingness to let him skate by in school earns her an almost chaperone-like reputation, and his apparent disdain. Yet, despite Yusuke’s disapproval of her hovering, Yukari refuses to let a new rumor about him spread. After following Yusuke home to discuss it, she watches him stop at a music studio. And there, Yukari sees—and hears—a side of Yusuke she had never imagined…

(Source: Yen Press)

214461.description:
“You are not the real saint, you’re nothing but a fake—!!!”

I, Eliane, am suddenly exiled. Not only that, my engagement was also annulled by Claude, who was both my fiancé and the first prince of my country.

Claude claims that Leticia is the ‘real saint’, but I know from the beginning, she is the woman he has been cheating on me with. So here I am, sharing his wish to cancel our engagement.

But, is exiling me truly a wise decision, I wonder? Exiling this me, the actual ‘real saint’ who has been setting up barriers and supporting this kingdom from shadows?

Maybe, just maybe, dragons and archdemons will invade my kingdom starting from tomorrow. Who knows—

—not like it’s any of my business anymore.

I have abandoned my own country and have thus decided to have a peaceful life.

Meanwhile, the kingdom, which has lost its true saint, is on the path to ruin.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)
synonyms: Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For!

214969.description: The fairytale of Little Red Riding Hood is as classic as they come, a familiar delivery of cookies and wine. But on this particular journey, Little Red Riding Hood... encounters a dead body?! As the mystery begins to unfold, familiar faces from other fairytales such as "Cinderella," "Hansel and Gretel," and "Sleeping Beauty" bring their own countless twists and tricks. Will she be able to solve the larger puzzle at the center of it all? A new detective is born!

title.romaji: Akazukin, Tabi no Tochuu de Shitai to Deau.

214067.description:
Captain Kepo and his crew, the inquisitive agent Alcia and naive junior teammate Rigel, arrive on an alien planet to explore, and attempt to understand, the mysterious remnants of a highly intelligent species that was once dominant, and is now long departed. The planet these three strange creatures are visiting? Earth.

(Source: Fantasia Festival)

214070.description:
A young girl arrives of the surface of a harsh and dangerous world. There she meets a boy prepared to confront those dangers. Each is there with a purpose, as the world around them gradually falls apart, atom by atom—or rather, datum by datum.

(Source: Fantasia Festival)

214072.description:
Renard, a young fox disguised as a human, works as an elevator boy in a prestigious department store, diligently carrying out his duties day after day while hiding his true form reflected in the mirror. Beneath his mask of a charming, fake smile, his cold eyes gleam as he hunts for his next prey.

(Source: YouTube Description, translated)

Note: Third-year student project by Nagomi Ueno for the Tama Arts University 2024 academic year.

214075.description:
Jacob, an 11-year-old boy who is looking for kokdu dolls to remember his last moments with his grandmother, accidentally enters the world of these dolls.

The "kokdu", literally "funeral doll", a key element in the work, is a wooden doll that adorned the bier (a carriage that carried a coffin) in the funeral culture of the Joseon Dynasty. It was considered a being that accompanied and protected the deceased, so that they would not feel lonely on their way to the afterlife. These dolls, which appeared in various forms, such as warriors, servants, clowns, and guides, embody the philosophy of Joseon-era Koreans, who viewed death not as something to be feared, but as a warm farewell and a new journey.

(Source: Etoday, translated)

214246.description: Kyuuko is born between a Shinto priest and a kitsune mom. Though her siblings are blessed with both beauty and intellect, Kyuuko doesn't mind that she is different. This is the story of Kyuuko going through life with her very own charm.

title.native: 機動戦士ガンダムRG XARX-ZERO

214380.description:
The three revelations delivered by the Autonomous Interstellar Object from another galaxy ushered in an age of unprecedented prosperity, allowing humanity to expand across the entire solar system.

Gravity Control. FTL Communication. Cognitive Materialization. Yet less than ten years after its discovery, the Object that had delivered these three revelations suddenly ran rampant, spawning an aggressive, self-proliferating ecosystem.

Humanity came to see this unknown ecosystem as the Apocalypse.

For three months, humanity fought the Apocalypse to a standstill in orbit above Earth. Forced to abandon the planet, humanity marked that year as A.A. 1—the first year After Apocalypse.

By A.A. 45, children born on the Moon and in space colonies have never known life without the Apocalypse.

And on the lunar surface, a boy named Ray Azumi awakens—
synonyms: 機動戦士ガンダムRG アレックスゼロ

214435.description: Feature film project directed by Tetsurou Araki.

214443.description:
Here we go again… Yukina had come to visit her husband, who’d been injured at work, but she was dumbfounded to see him striking up conversations with every woman in sight. She ignored him and sat down on a bench in the hallway. Then, a cup of coffee was handed to her. It was from Yuto, a young man visiting his girlfriend—whom he’d met recently—and who was doting on her with a friendly, refreshing charm. For Yukina, who couldn’t help but compare him to her husband, it was just a distraction—perfect for simply watching—and she was supposed to be savoring that moment…

After seeing a flyer for a part-time job at a newly opened café, she rushed in. Standing across from her at the counter was Yuto, the man she’d met at the hospital. She was hired on the spot, and at the newly opened shop, it was just her and Yuto, the owner… For this married woman, who had devoted herself entirely to her husband, this new encounter marked the beginning of a daily life steeped in transgression—lewd, maddening, and utterly intoxicating…

(Source: Getchu, translated)

title.native: みいちゃんと山田さん

214451.description:
In the heart of Shinjuku, there are a variety of host and hostess nightclubs open to customers seeking a night of indulgence with a gorgeous companion. Yamada is one of those companions. She balances university and work, but finds herself more interested in becoming a model hostess than a star pupil. The pay is too tempting to resist, which is why so many girls come and go in the industry. But in 2012, she meets someone completely different. Mii-chan is a petite young woman who seems to be rather useless at most things—barely able to read or write and, unfortunately, clumsy—earning her ridicule from staff and customers alike. However, her bright energy and endless motivation proves hard to ignore, and Yamada finds herself drawn in by Mii-chan’s charm.

A beautiful and tragic story about an unlikely friendship and the unfortunate end that separated them forever.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: みいちゃんと山田さん

214483.description:
Seven immortal siblings born in England possess humanity's ultimate dream: eternal life. But their gift makes them targets for the criminal underworld, corrupt hospitals, and international military organizations! After centuries apart, this extraordinary family reunites for a thrilling new chapter in their lives.

(Source: Shonengahosha, translated)

214484.description:
The village of Hoori lies deep in the middle of the mountains, inaccessible by rail. Since there isn’t much interaction with its surroundings, the town seems like it is stuck in the past. However, it is because of this exact olden feel and subsequent development that it has turned into a nice hot-springs town for tourists.

One of the popular sightseeing spots is the legendary katana Murasamemaru, embedded in stone. No one has been able to pull it out… until Masaomi somehow broke it in half. He has to take responsibility for his actions: “Marriage” with ‘shrine maiden princess’ Yoshino!? He was perplexed at the unexpected turn of events, but this is only just the beginning. What lies ahead for him is a much more peculiar and mysterious life, including his new fiancée, a mysterious girl who only he could touch, and the secret behind the curse that remains on the town.

What will become of Masaomi’s love amidst his rapidly changing life? The answer lies within the Murasamemaru in his hands.

(Source: VNDB)
